column1: # MUSHY-60 driven closed-loop replay of 2026-08-08 (UTC). Chamber model started at the first recorded RH/temp of the day and driven FREE for 24h with the real per-second ambient AH (MUSHY-64 fixture) and real recorded chamber temperature (a DRIVEN INPUT -- this model has no thermal dynamics) at every step. No parameter tuned; Q/F are the unmodified MUSHY-60 fitted values. duty_recorded is the time-weighted held state of the edge-published fc.humidifier relay
